correctness.rationale: The lower bound was reconstructed for arbitrary positive admissible weights after normalizing the minimum edge weight to one. The stated dual-feasible function on an attachment clique edge yields \(LR\le P(2r+R)\), and the elementary distortion bounds then give the quadratic inequality in the distortion. For the matching weight, direct edge-type minimization of the dual objective gives positive pendant and inner-clique curvature and the attachment-edge numerator equal to the defining quadratic. Independent evaluation over 600 parameter pairs confirmed the resulting formulas and unit-weight threshold; the finite sweep was only a stress test of the analytic proof.
